edition.title: This weekend on Keowee + Jocassee
edition.dek: Jazz on the Alley has gone quiet for the season, but Seneca's Blue Ridge Arts Center opens four new exhibits Friday, Keowee Brewing and Jocassee Valley Brewing both keep their free Friday–Saturday music going, and a Jocassee Wild Child benefit closes the weekend with live music and food trucks.

events.title: Opening reception: four new exhibits at Blue Ridge Arts Center
events.body: "Shared Vision," "Gray with a Pop of Color," "Same, Same, But Different," and "The Art of Learning" all open together, with local artists on hand. The shows run through December 18.
events.note: Free · Reception 5:30–7pm · Blue Ridge Arts Center, 111 E. South 2nd St., Seneca

events.title: Free live music Friday and Saturday at Keowee Brewing
events.body: Keowee Brewing runs live music both nights, rain or shine, like clockwork — the lineup posts to their Facebook events page closer to showtime rather than the website, so check there or ask at the bar.
events.note: Free · 6:30–8:30pm Fri & Sat · Keowee Brewing, 401 E. Main St., Seneca

events.title: Weekend music and food trucks at Jocassee Valley Brewing
events.body: No specific acts were posted for this weekend as of publish time, but Jocassee Valley Brewing's live music and food truck lineup runs Friday and Saturday as usual — check their calendar for who's playing before you head out.
events.note: Free to attend · Open Wed–Sat 9am–9pm, Sun 12–7pm · Jocassee Valley Brewing, Salem

events.title: Jocassee Wild Child benefit: live music, vendors, and food trucks
events.body: A benefit for Jocassee Wild Child's outdoor environmental education programs, with music from Three Rivers, Matt Phillips, and the Blue Wall Ramblers, local vendors, and Farm to Fire Pizza's wood-fired truck.
events.note: Time and location weren't posted yet — check Visit Oconee's events calendar or call (800) 910-4371

plan.title: Eat in Seneca before the Blue Ridge Arts Center reception
plan.body: The opening reception runs 5:30–7pm, so grab an early dinner downtown first.

plan.title: Get on the water while it's quiet
plan.body: Mid-November mornings are calm and the ramps are empty — launch early on Keowee or Jocassee before the Saturday brewery crowds pick up.
